question: Can the action prediction horizon H be expanded beyond 32 (H48/H64)? Is it the same as the r-sweep?
answer_short: No, H>32 has NOT been run. The r-sweep changed the replan interval r<=H=32, NOT H. H expansion is a separate H-HORIZON-STUDY.

facts.claim: inference horizon is an explicit argument (no hard cap at 32 in the API)
facts.detail: def infer_action(self, prompt, input_image, action_horizon, proprio, ..., num_inference_steps=20, seed=...)

facts.claim: inference builds action tokens of shape [1, action_horizon, action_dim] for any H
action RoPE cache is 1024 long (structural cap far above 64)
RoPE guard only raises if seq_len > 1024
facts.detail: if seq_len > self.freqs.shape[0]: raise 'Action token length exceeds RoPE cache'  -> H48/H64 pass (<=1024)

facts.claim: TRAINING requires action_horizon divisible by video transitions (num_frames-1)

facts.detail: if num_frames % 4 != 1: raise; valid T in {1,5,9,13,17,...}

divisibility_with_current_9frame_video.note: with current 9-frame windows H48 and H64 already satisfy H%(num_frames-1)==0 (48/8=6, 64/8=8); H52 (52/8=6.5) is invalid. Keeping a 4:1 action:transition ratio (13/17 frames) is a temporal design preference, not a hard gate.

three_distinct_things.r: replan interval: execute min(r,H) steps then re-infer. THIS is what was swept (r<=32). r>32 == r32 alias, NOT a longer prediction.
three_distinct_things.H: action_horizon: how many future steps ONE inference predicts. Fixed at 32 in every experiment so far. H>32 = THIS separate study.
three_distinct_things.K: num_inference_steps (denoise iterations, 5 in eval). Unrelated to r or H.

what_is_needed_to_actually_expand_H: ZERO-TRAINING PROBE (allowed, exploratory OOD): call the frozen H32 checkpoint with action_horizon=48/64. It RUNS (RoPE 1024, tokens built at H), but positions 32..47/63 are UNTRAINED -> outputs are OOD, not a valid quality claim. Needs GPU (load model) -> wait for a lock gap.

REAL EXPANSION (to claim performance): retrain at H48/H64 with new optimizer budget (WAIT_BUDGET_FOR_TRAINING), new data windows/labels (optionally 13/17 frames to keep 4:1), new milestone evals. Not authorized; separate H-HORIZON-STUDY.
guardrails: never fold H>32 into the r curve or label r=52 as 'H52'
H x r is a 2D design; (a) fix H vary r, (b) fix r vary H, (c) both vary must be separate comparisons
a zero-training H48/H64 forward is exploratory OOD inference only; must be labeled as such
next: stage H1 as PREP(source-audit done)+READY(zero-training probe in a GPU gap); H48/H64 training stays WAIT_BUDGET_FOR_TRAINING; GPU owned by F0 now
